<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0409-24-46" status="unreviewed">
                  dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5575">dbang sde</rs><note type="editorial">For "dbang phyug sde"?</note></note><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5575">kha <lb n="68b6"/> 1</rs> na re rtags rtsod gzhi de dang sgrub bya'i chos kyis mthun pa nyid kho na la yod pa zhes rjes 'gro dngos su brjod pas ldog pa shugs las grub pa yin mod kyis | yin kyang ldog pa ngon su ma brjod na bsgrub bya chos kyis dgos 'gal kho na ma rtags 'gog pa'i || sgrub bya chos kyi ldog pa las ldog chos bzhan la rtags 'gog pa'i log
               <lb n="68b7"/>rdzogs yod po de'i ched du mthun phyogs Na pa la rtags Na nyid ces ldog pa dngos su brjod pas | mthun phyogs Nas kho na la rtags Na pa yin gyis ldog pa gzhan la yang 'gog pa ma yin la chos kyis dngos 'gal kho na la yang 'gog pa ma yin no zhes nges par bya ba'i ched du ldog pa logs su smos so zhes zer ro || </seg></TEI>
